title: Crossbow Indicator
description: This pack changes the crossbow pulling animations. It shows a distinct colour indicating on whether you are far from having an arrow in your crossbow.
body:
A CrossBow PvP **Texture/Resource** Pack to help you know exactly when to time your shots! Some of the following Changes are listed below:

* Crossbow Pulling Animations

These are only some of the following changes done to this pack. Also it works on any version thats 1.14+
With no mod requirements! So you can use it on a completly vanilla setup.

Also my second ever resource pack to get published, if you wanna check my first click on [This!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/scythemace-breachdensity)
